<thought>To retrieve a retrosynthetic template for the flavanone product, I will query the template catalog using the flavanone SMILES and provide empty lists for the optional criteria (they satisfy the requirement of being list parameters). This should return at least one template ID that can later be applied to obtain the precursors.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(C2=CC=CC=C2)C3=CC=CC=C13",
    "functional_groups_broken": [],
    "functional_groups_formed": [],
    "bonds_formed": [],
    "bonds_broken": [],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
